name: Cadmean Fields

stars.name: Cadmean A
stars.notes: Hot young white star whose harsh ultraviolet flood sterilizes the inner system; nothing here has ever evolved, yet something here was built.

planets.name: Spartoi
planets.notes: Airless basalt world bearing the Fields themselves: megalithic ruins arranged like sown furrows radiating from a central acropolis of unknown origin.

planets.name: Ismenus
planets.notes: Cratered regolith world; survey markers left here have twice been found rearranged into neat rows.

planets.name: Dirce
planets.notes: Tidally stressed furnace world whose lava fountains feed the Drakon Belt with fresh silicate debris.

planets.name: Antiope
planets.notes: Dominant giant of the mid-system; its shepherding gravity holds the Drakon Belt in place.

planets.name: Zethus
planets.notes: Pale ammonia giant in resonance with Antiope; its moonlets show ancient quarry scars of impossible age.

planets.name: Nycteis
planets.notes: Frigid shell world with a buried salt ocean kept liquid by radiogenic heat.

planets.name: Harmonia
planets.notes: Ringed ice giant-moon hybrid oddity; its rings are geometrically regular, almost designed.

planets.name: Illyria
planets.notes: Outermost wanderer, likely captured; long-period telemetry suggests it arrived within recorded history.

anomalies.name: Dragon-Teeth Field
anomalies.notes: Fragments removed from the Spartoi ruins regrow overnight into black crystalline teeth; sampled structures begin rebuilding themselves within days.

asteroid_belts.name: Drakon Belt
asteroid_belts.notes: Violent collision cascade fed by Dirce's eruptions; hull-tearing debris makes any approach to Spartoi a careful piloting exercise.

stations.name: Teiresis Observatory
stations.notes: Blind-crewed research platform studying the ruins by telepresence; staff rotate every six months after psych evaluations.

faction_control.notes: Administered under academic charter by a consortium of universities; navies honor the charter mainly because no one wants the lattice samples.

history: Long-range spectrographs flagged the system when light from Spartoi showed manufactured geometry beneath a star too young to host builders.
The first landing confirmed megalithic ruins predating Cadmean A itself — structures older than their own sun, apparently migrated or seeded.
After a recovered fragment rebuilt itself aboard the survey ship Kithairon, access was restricted and Teiresis Observatory was founded to watch the Fields grow back.
description: Cadmean Fields burns under a fierce white A-class star barely a billion years old, flooding eight sterile worlds with radiation no life could abide. Rocky planets crowd the inner system, twin gas giants dominate the middle reaches behind a dense debris belt, and frozen Harmonia rings the outer dark.

Minimal traffic serves only Teiresis Observatory, whose blind-crewed staff study the impossible: ruins on Spartoi older than the star that now scorches them, arranged in furrows like a planted field. The consortium keeps the site sealed while the Dragon-Teeth lattice demonstrates that whatever built the Fields is not entirely finished building.

Three questions haunt the charter. Who sowed a dead world around a star that did not yet exist, and how does stone remember across a stellar rebirth? The lattice grows a little further along its furrows each year, and the observatory's standing order is simple: measure, never harvest, and above all do not answer if the Fields ever ask.
